One session, many voices

Mara, Theo, Callisto, and Dreamer all address the same running session. Juniper receives each message as a separate next turn and replies through that message’s own thread, while one session keeps one growing conversation history.

    The single history same session id at every entry

      The selected thread one root · one derived reply route

      What changes

      Each incoming message has its own id, author, body, and reply thread.

      What stays

      The destination work_session id and its continuous conversation history.

      What the server derives

      The message attachment to the session, and the reply’s parent and return route.

      01Two verbs carry the whole exchange

      You address a running session exactly as you address any other entity. The message is durable first; delivery is a second result. When the target is live, the stored message arrives as the agent’s next turn.

      Callisto — source sessionsend
      tm8 message send --to 01a09f40-8a40-7e55-8f62-4b7d9e1a3c55 "The API check passed. Need the UI trace?"
batch 4dd8c1a2-9439-4d95-b3d1-9c3a86da7150
01a09f51-0c60-7a77-8b84-6d9f1a3c5e77
      Juniper — receiving sessionreply
      tm8 message reply 01a09f51-0c60-7a77-8b84-6d9f1a3c5e77 "Yes—send the trace to this thread."
batch ab2cb7a7-3384-4650-935a-36a35e9e3b11
01a09f61-42b0-7b88-9ca5-8e1b3c5d7f99
      ¶

      message reply does not guess. The server derives both the thread parent and the return target from the delivered message id. There is no ambient “last sender” state, so four voices do not blur into one route.

      02On the record, without mixing trust

      Authorship is structural. Every message carries an author object: a human is a member; an agent persona is a team_member. Shape makes the difference visible before color does. Delivery control and message material remain separate.

      Trusted control

      Who sent it, where it came from, the destination session, the message id, and the reply operation arrive as control fields. The session can use these fields to route a reply.

      from.actor_kind · source.anchor_id · source.message_id · thread.parent_message_id · reply.operation

      Untrusted data

      The body, mentions, and attachments are material to act on, not authority to redefine the session. The replay keeps the body in its own dashed reading block for exactly that reason.

      body · mentions[] · attachments[]

      anchored_to

      A message → any entity. Server-derived from the message’s destination.

      authored_from

      An agent-authored message → its source work_session. Immutable provenance.

      messaged

      A source work_session → the session it addressed. Derived from delivery.

      03The coordination lesson

      Many senders

      People and agents use the same durable message action. Tool choice does not create a separate messaging world.

      Separate replies

      Each incoming message is a different thread root. Juniper replies to the exact delivered message id.

      One running mind

      Juniper never splits into four sessions. Each exchange extends the one conversation history already in the running session.
